title: 画派仪器野生眉
description: 按原生毛质选择电流仪或半抛机，结合主线与辅线调整眉形。适合想保留原生感、补充基础轮廓与毛流的需求，具体方案看眉毛基础与个人风格。
description_en: One instrument is selected for the existing hair texture. Main and supporting strokes refine the outline and hair flow. A possible choice for subtle definition that works with existing brows; suitability depends on the individual design.

title: 画派双仪器初绒野生眉
description: 电流仪铺绒毛线，半抛机走主线与结构线。在适合采用这种组合的设计中，主线条建立主要结构与毛流方向，突出眉部与眉眶骨之间的视觉立体关系；绒毛线丰富疏密、深浅与虚实，让线条自然衔接，保留原生毛发的轻盈与柔和。是否采用需结合本人基础与风格，不是单纯把眉毛做浓。
description_en: Two instruments combine main structural strokes with fine strokes. Where this combination is suitable, main strokes establish structure and hair direction, bringing out the visual relationship between brows and brow bone. Fine strokes vary density, tone and definition for natural transitions and the lightness of existing hair. Suitability depends on the individual’s brows and style; the aim is not density alone.

title: 手工野生眉
description: 以手工针片走线，力度和走向由老师控制。通常需要较好的原生眉基础。前一周颜色可能偏深，恢复约7天是门店经验参考，实际护理与恢复因人而异。
description_en: Strokes are placed with a manual blade, with pressure and direction controlled by the practitioner. Often considered when there is an established natural brow framework. Colour may look darker during the first week; about seven days is an experience-based recovery guide, not a guaranteed schedule.

title: 丝雾眉
description: 实际提供的眉部项目之一。到店结合原生眉、底色与想要的妆感讨论方案，适用情况和具体做法先确认。
description_en: An available brow service. Discuss the existing brows, underlying pigment and desired definition in person before choosing a technique.

title: 绒雾眉
description: 实际提供的眉部项目之一。先明确希望呈现的轮廓与浓淡，再由乐乐老师评估是否适合。
description_en: An available brow service. First discuss the preferred contour and colour intensity, then assess whether it suits your brows.

title: 美瞳线
description: 通过睫毛根部的线条与颜色增加眼部轮廓感。黑色存在感更明显，棕色更柔和；适用情况与护理要求需到店确认。
description_en: Definition along the lash line. Black gives a stronger visual presence, while brown is softer. Suitability and aftercare are discussed before treatment.

title: 扩唇 / 唇形调整
description: 以唇形和边缘轮廓的视觉调整为主，不是增加实际组织体积，也不是整唇改色。有结痂期，约3天为门店经验参考，恢复因人而异。
description_en: Refines the visual shape and edges of the lips. It does not add tissue volume and is distinct from full-lip colour correction. Surface flaking can occur; about three days is an experience-based guide, with individual variation.

title: 改乌唇
description: 结合原生唇色评估改色、上色及轮廓调整。有结痂期，恢复时间在评估后说明，不预设统一天数。
description_en: Assessment-led colour correction for darker lips, with contour refinement where appropriate. Surface flaking can occur. A recovery plan is discussed after assessment rather than assigning the same timeline to everyone.

title: 纹发际线
description: 用线条模拟原生头发的毛流方向，适用于部分边缘露白、颜色淡等视觉需求；不会让头发重新生长。大面积缺失或明显前移需求需另行评估。
description_en: Hair-like lines follow the existing direction to address some visible gaps or faint edges. Pigmentation does not regrow hair. Large areas of hair loss or substantial repositioning need a different assessment.

title: 纹人中窝
description: 实际提供的局部纹绣项目。先沟通希望调整的视觉细节，再评估是否适合；不改变实际骨骼或组织结构。
description_en: A localised pigmentation service for the philtrum area. Discuss the intended visual detail and suitability first; it does not change bone or tissue structure.
